name: Manuel II of Portugal
role: Last king of Portugal (1908–1910), later exiled royal claimant
summary: Manuel defended constitutional monarchy, gradual reform and Portugal’s British alliance. He promoted labour-related study and colonial development, while later opposing an immediate armed restoration.

sources.title: Letter to Aires de Ornelas, 1 November 1919, published in Diário de Notícias on 3 December 1919; reproduced in A Questão Dinástica
sources.author: Manuel II; documents collected and presented by José Manuel Quintas
sources.usedFor: Own public letter on constitutional obligations, restoration, popular consultation and the British alliance; opponents’ annotations excluded.

sources.title: História, discurso político e liderança em Portugal: um diálogo entre presente e passado à luz do Diário do Governo (2019)
sources.author: Pedro Emanuel Mendes
sources.usedFor: Detailed analysis and quotations from the 29 April 1908 parliamentary speech.

sources.title: Testamento do Rei D. Manuel II, 20 September 1915, full text reproduced from Diário de Notícias, 16 August 1932
sources.author: Manuel II; transcription hosted by Monarquia Portuguesa
sources.usedFor: Museum bequest and protection of inherited cultural collections.

sources.title: D. Manuel II, O Portal da História
sources.author: Based on works directed or written by Joel Serrão and Joaquim Veríssimo Serrão
sources.usedFor: Personal labour-reform initiative and support for Allied participation in World War I.

sources.title: Manuel II of Portugal
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors
sources.usedFor: Career overview, social question, exile, succession and bibliographical work.
